result.topic_en: The first page of Gauss's mathematical diary for 1796, with dated entries on constructing the regular 17-gon, quadratic residues, cyclotomic periods, prime decompositions, symmetric functions of roots, and continued-fraction transformations of divergent series.
result.transcription:
1796.
* Principia quibus innititur sectio circuli,
ac divisibilitas eiusdem geometrica in
septemdecim partes &c.          Mart. 30. Brunsv.

* Numerorum primorum non omnes
numeros infra ipsos residua quadratica
esse posse demonstratione munitum.
                    Apr. 8. Ibid.

Formula pro cosinibus angulorum periphe-
riae submultiplorum expressionem gene-
raliorem {+non+} admittent nisi in duas periodos
                    Apr. 12. Ibid.

* Amplificatio normae residuorum ad residua
et mensuras non indivisibiles.
                    Apr. 29 Gotting.

Numeri cuiusvis divisibilitas varia in binos primos
                    Mai. 14 Gott.

* Coefficientes aequationum per radicum potestatis
additas facile dantur.     Mai. 23 Gott.

Transformatio seriei $1-2+8-64\ldots$ in fractionem
continuam $\cfrac{1}{1+\cfrac{2}{1+\cfrac{2}{1+\cfrac{8}{1+\cfrac{12}{1+\cfrac{32}{1+\cfrac{56}{1+128}}}}}}}$
                    Mai. 24 G.

$1-1+1.3-1.3.7+1.3.7.15 = \cfrac{1}{1+\cfrac{1}{1+\cfrac{2}{1+\cfrac{6}{1+\cfrac{12}{1+28}}}}}$

methods.what: Principles of cyclotomy (division of the circle) and the geometric constructibility of the regular 17-gon
methods.quote:
Principia quibus innititur sectio circuli,
ac divisibilitas eiusdem geometrica in
septemdecim partes &c.

methods.what: Proof that, for a prime, not every number below it can be a quadratic residue
methods.quote:
Numerorum primorum non omnes
numeros infra ipsos residua quadratica
esse posse demonstratione munitum.

methods.what: Result on the expression of cosines of submultiples of the full angle via periods (Gaussian periods)
methods.quote:
Formula pro cosinibus angulorum periphe-
riae submultiplorum expressionem gene-
raliorem {+non+} admittent nisi in duas periodos

methods.what: Extension of the law of quadratic residues to composite (non-prime) residues and moduli
methods.quote:
Amplificatio normae residuorum ad residua
et mensuras non indivisibiles.

methods.what: Number of ways a number can be decomposed into two primes
methods.quote: Numeri cuiusvis divisibilitas varia in binos primos

methods.what: Coefficients of polynomial equations obtained from power sums of the roots (Newton's identities)
methods.quote:
Coefficientes aequationum per radicum potestatis
additas facile dantur.

methods.what: Transformation of the divergent series 1-2+8-64... into a continued fraction

items.quote:
Principia quibus innititur sectio circuli,
ac divisibilitas eiusdem geometrica in
septemdecim partes &c.
items.english: The principles on which the division of the circle rests, and its geometric divisibility into seventeen parts, etc.

items.quote:
Numerorum primorum non omnes
numeros infra ipsos residua quadratica
esse posse demonstratione munitum.
items.english: That not all numbers below a prime can be quadratic residues of it, secured by a proof.

items.quote:
Formula pro cosinibus angulorum periphe-
riae submultiplorum expressionem gene-
raliorem {+non+} admittent nisi in duas periodos
items.english: Formulas for the cosines of submultiple angles of the circumference will not admit a more general expression except in two periods.

items.quote:
Amplificatio normae residuorum ad residua
et mensuras non indivisibiles.
items.english: Extension of the law of residues to residues and moduli that are not indivisible (i.e. not prime).

items.quote: Numeri cuiusvis divisibilitas varia in binos primos
items.english: The various divisibility of any number into two primes.

items.quote:
Coefficientes aequationum per radicum potestatis
additas facile dantur.
items.english: The coefficients of equations are easily given by the sums of powers of the roots.
